text: Eeh I'm ever so sorry to be bothering you this late pet. I've got me grandson stopping over, he's 2, and he just will not settle the night. His temperature's 37.6. Otherwise he's canny, wide awake, blethering away to me and watching his programmes on the telly like nowt's up. I'm probably being a daft old worrier, his mam says I fret too much, but I thought I'd better check with somebody. Sorry again.
